message.content:
**Verification:**

**(1) Jagged halo + core arcs:** ✅ PASS. All three images show bifurcated-style bolts with bright pale core + darker yellow halo outline. Best in Image 3 (thick, forked, recursive jitter). Image 1 has good jagged segments with branch-off near enemy 3.

**(2) Struck enemies rim-lit in bolt color:** ⚠️ PARTIAL. Image 3 enemies show clear yellow rim-lights on limbs/heads (strong improvement). Image 1 enemies are still mostly flat white — only minor yellow tint near contact points; enemy 3's rim is present but the left two enemies read unlit.

**(3) Chains connect blade→enemy→enemy:** ✅ PASS. Image 1: bolt runs sword→enemy 1→enemy 2→enemy 3→offscreen, terminating ON bodies with contact glow. Image 3: bolt descends from sky→enemy 1→enemy 2→player sword; body-termination visible with flash at each junction.

**(4) Presence 0–1 per image:** ✅ PASS. No ghost/duplicate bolts; clean single channel per strike (Image 3's sky bolt + sword link read as one chain).

**(5) Remaining issues, ranked:**
1. **Image 1 rim-lighting weak/inconsistent** — enemies 1–2 lack the bolt-color edge glow that Image 3 nails; apply the same rim-pass uniformly.
2. **Image 1 bolt tail exits screen abruptly** — final segment toward right edge fades with no dim-out; add falloff.
3. **Image 3 sky-bolt origin ambiguous** — top bolt enters from off-screen with no source flash; a brief impact flash at entry would ground it.
4. Minor: Image 2 charge glow ring is static-looking; slight pulse would sell the "crawl."

**Overall:** 3.5/5 checks fully solid; core ray-traced chain behavior works.
